PROFILE

Business Analyst with 6+ years of experience in financial services specializing in global payments and wealth management operations. Proven expertise in transaction analysis, reconciliation management, and business requirement documentation (BRD/FRD) to drive operational and financial reporting accuracy. Experienced in global payment networks including ACH, Fedwire, RTP, SEPA Instant. financial Adept transactions, identifying process gaps, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with cross- functional teams in Agile environments to improve payment processing workflows and operational efficiency.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Davies Group, Pune, Maharashtra Treasury Analyst 05/2026 – Present | Pune, India

Prepare daily cash forecasts for 20+ global client accounts, managing liquidity positions and delivering treasury reports with 99%+ accuracy.

Oversee payment processing and cross-border payment flows, resolving lifecycle exceptions to ensure timely settlement and operational accuracy. Execute EBITDA sweep and related fund-movement workflows, optimizing cash utilization across accounts in line with defined treasury controls.

Coordinate treasury team activities across 8+ members, aligning task ownership, process adherence, and cross-functional collaboration for daily operational delivery.

Apex Group LTD, Pune, Maharashtra Senior Associate (Business Analyst) 12/2024 – 04/2026 | Pune, India

Validated investment positions, cash balances, and portfolio data for global wealth management clients, ensuring accurate portfolio reconciliation and investor reporting. Performed reconciliation analysis on financial datasets using Bloomberg Terminal, identifying 25+ monthly discrepancies and improving portfolio reporting accuracy by 15%.

Documented business and functional requirements (BRD/FRD) to enable reporting enhancements and operational process improvements. Conducted root cause analysis on reconciliation breaks, collaborating with stakeholders to resolve reporting discrepancies. Coordinated with cross-functional teams using Jira in Agile environments to track issues and improve reporting workflows.

Bank of New York, Pune, Maharashtra Trade Execution Analyst 07/2022 – 11/2024 | Pune, India

Processed high-volume payment transactions across global payment networks including FedNow, SEPA Instant, RTP, Fedwire, ACH, and SWIFT-based payment systems. Investigated 40+ daily payment exceptions across the end-to-end payment lifecycle, reducing settlement delays by 18% through timely resolution and reconciliation.

Assisted cross-border payment processing for 500+ monthly transactions while ensuring financial reporting compliance aligned with US GAAP standards. Monitored treasury KPIs and payment transaction trends, identifying operational inefficiencies and recommending process improvements. Coordinated User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for payment workflow enhancements, validating 50+ transaction scenarios prior to production deployment.

CORE SKILLS

Business Analysis

Requirement Gathering • BRD/FRD Documentation • Stakeholder management • Process Improvement • Root Cause Analysis • UAT Coordination Payment & Financial Domain

Global Payment Lifecycle • Cross-Border Payments • Reconciliation Analysis • Wealth Management Operations • Treasury KPI Monitoring • Financial Reporting (US GAAP) Data & Reporting

Financial Data Analysis • Transaction Analysis • Operational Reporting • Process Performance Monitoring EDUCATION

Master of business Administration (MBA) Dr, DY Patil University, Pune, Maharashtra 05/2017 – 06/2019 | Pune, Maharashtra Percentage/CGPA : 70

Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) Gujarat University, Ahmedabad, Gujrat 05/2014 – 04/2017 | Ahmedabad, India Percentage/CGPA : 65

DOMAIN EXPERTISE

Global Payment Systems

ACH | Fedwire | RTP | SEPA Instant

Payment Messaging & Standards

SWIFT | ISO 20022 | Payment Message Processing

Payment Processing

Payment Lifecycle | Payment Settlement | Transaction Monitoring

State Street, Pune Maharashtra Senior Financial Analyst 07/2019 – 06/2022 | Pune, India

Reviewed 1,000+ monthly global payment transactions including ACH and cross-border transfers within large-scale banking operations. Investigated transaction discrepancies across the payment lifecycle, performing financial data analysis to identify root causes.

Documented operational processes and aided requirement analysis for system enhancements in Agile delivery environments. Participated in UAT validation activities, verifying transaction accuracy and confirming system changes met business requirements.

Crisil LTD, Pune, Maharashtra Financial Analyst Intern 06/2018 – 07/2018 | Pune, India

Examined financial statements and market data for 15+ companies, aiding credit research and company analysis deliverables. Conducted financial statement analysis and market research to assist credit evaluation and investment recommendations. Evaluated financial ratios and performance metrics to identify industry trends and financial insights.

Assisted in preparing analytical research reports for investment and credit analysis.

ACHIEVEMENTS

Successfully led the transition of an income processing function from the Hyderabad client location to the Pune base location within 2 months, ensuring seamless knowledge transfer and uninterrupted operations.

Played a key role in payment modernization initiatives by driving schema change management and enabling process enhancements through coordination with cross-functional teams.

TOOLS & METHODOLOGIES

Project Management Tools

JIRA | Confluence

Data Analysis & Reporting Tools

Power BI | Microsoft Excel

Financial and Market data Platforms

Bloomberg

Methodology - Agile
